Bangladesh Secures Historic First Test Cricket Win Over Australia

Bangladesh achieved their first-ever Test cricket victory against Australia, winning the series-opening match in Darwin by nine wickets. The win marks a significant achievement for Bangladesh cricket. Australian cricket figures and commentators acknowledged the historic nature of the win, with some calling it an "embarrassing moment" for Australian cricket. Bangladesh captain Najmul Hossain Shanto hailed the triumph as their "biggest win ever" and called for more Test opportunities.
